description: The EGNOS User Support Website publishes the operational status of the European satellite-based augmentation system. Contents: an EGNOS signal status panel showing the state of each geostationary satellite (on the day read PRN 121 and PRN 136 in Safety of Life mode and PRN 123 in test mode), real-time, forecast and historical performance pages for the Safety of Life service for aviation, real-time, historical and pass-to-pass pages for the Open Service, EDAS service status for the data access channels (SL0, SL2, NTRIP, FTP, SISNET and data filtering nodes), a list of planned outages (for example EDAS maintenance on 1 October 2026 for one hour), and resources such as the EBCAST tool, LPV procedures map and training material. Producer: the EGNOS service provider on behalf of EUSPA. Coverage: the European EGNOS service area. Access: public web pages; the EDAS streams themselves are a separate service that requires registration according to EGNOS practice, not confirmed on the page read. Licence and cost: free to view; no licence stated. Caveats: dashboards show current and recent status, and long-term archives need the historical pages or monthly reports. Simulation uses: observed service status and planned outage timing calibrate availability and resilience scenarios for navigation-dependent systems. Related record: the analysis of the October 2024 EGNOS degradation (case_study-egnos-degradation-october-2024-space-weather).
